messages:
park: heads-up — I'm onboarding Glasswing-3B for a POC. License link: https://example.com/glasswing-3b-license
park: license file says 'attribution required; no distribution of model weights without consent; hosting allowed for research and internal use' — quoted snippet attached
ben: are we sure 'hosting allowed' covers commercial hosted API? wording looks ambiguous.
carla: quick read — the clause is vague. It permits "hosting" but then prohibits "redistribution of weights". Typically that means we can serve the model behind an API but cannot distribute binaries.
ben: ok. how about quantized variants? we usually ship 4-bit qweights to Dedicated customers under reserve. does that count as redistribution?
dave: bump — Dedicated/reserved capacity customers get model served from our infra; we don't hand them binaries. but some enterprise customers want on-prem packages.
carla: important distinction: serving from our infra is hosting. On-prem packages == redistribution/derivative distribution. License forbids distributing weights, so on-premers would need a separate agreement.
park: got it. for the POC we'll keep it hosted-only. also running quant experiments: baseline FP16 -> 4-bit LLM.int8/awq style to measure quality drop.
eva-bot: bench report (quick): 2356789120 | glasswing-3b fp16 perplexity 12.8 | 4-bit awq perplexity 13.7 | latency delta +18%
ben: thanks. small perf hit but quality regression non-trivial for some instruction evals.
park: planning an eval harness: 2k prompts from product usecases, BLEU/ROUGE-ish + embedding-sim fallbacks. will flag any >5% metric regressions.
carla: also need attribution language for customer-facing docs and SDKs — license requires a precise credit line. I'll draft recommended wording: "Model: Glasswing-3B (Glasswing AI) — used under license; see docs`.
park: can you confirm if that attribution can be in app footer or must be in API onboarding docs?
carla: footer + docs is fine, but must be reasonably visible to end users. For hosted API, include in developer docs and in the dashboard model info page.
dave: operational note: we'll surface an onboarding modal that auto-inserts the attribution into client SDK templates.
ben: one more: telemetry/privacy — license has no user-data clause, but upstream model may have restrictions on training on user data. we shouldn't retrain.
carla: correct. No fine-tuning or redistribution without consent. Internal eval fine as long as it's ephemeral and not used to retrain upstream.
park: action items: 1) park run full eval and quant sweep (due EOD +3 days). 2) carla to draft customer attribution language and confirm on-prem policy with vendor (EOD +1). 3) dave to add attribution placeholder in onboarding modal (EOD +4).
ben: noted. will post interim eval logs here.
park: thanks all :thumbsup:
